from itertools import accumulate
from math import gcd


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    p = [0] + list(accumulate(a))

    hull: list[int] = []
    head = 0
    best_num = p[k]
    best_den = k

    for r in range(k, n + 1):
        c = r - k
        pc = p[c]
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            i = hull[-2]
            j = hull[-1]
            if (p[j] - p[i]) * (c - j) >= (pc - p[j]) * (j - i):
                hull.pop()
            else:
                break
        hull.append(c)

        pr = p[r]
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            i = hull[head]
            j = hull[head + 1]
            if (pr - p[i]) * (r - j) <= (pr - p[j]) * (r - i):
                head += 1
            else:
                break

        l = hull[head]
        num = pr - p[l]
        den = r - l
        if num * best_den > best_num * den:
            best_num = num
            best_den = den

    g = gcd(best_num, best_den)
    return [best_num // g, best_den // g]
